content.short: A decentralized non-custodial derivatives exchange for permissionless perpetual swap trading with high leverage.
content.description:
ApeX Protocol is a decentralized, non-custodial derivatives exchange designed for permissionless trading of perpetual swap contracts. It features "ApeX Omni," a modular multichain liquidity framework that enables gasless trading across chains like Arbitrum, Base, and BNB Chain. The platform supports up to 100x leverage on various trading pairs while maintaining full user self-custody.

By combining CEX-like efficiency with on-chain security via StarkEx and zkLink, ApeX offers a professional trading experience. It also includes social trading, allowing users to follow and replicate strategies from top-performing traders globally.
